page.layout: One blank page of paper with faint show-through and stains; a handwritten or printed numeral "7" appears at the upper left corner, outside the printed block.
page.notes: The page is blank apart from stains, foxing and faint show-through from the facing page. The numeral "7" at the upper left is a handwritten or stamped mark, not printed text, so it is not transcribed. The dark patches at the right edge are damage to the paper and the binding.
